wargear.name: Icon of the Sixteenth
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scarred eye-icon carried by the Legion's proudest companies, a reminder of who they serve. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Mournival oath-seals
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Wax and iron seals pressed over the heart of a bodyguard who has sworn to fall before the Warmaster does. The model gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Laurel of the Victors
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A circlet of beaten gold awarded after a bloody triumph. Gives the model Victor's Laurel.

wargear.name: Pennant of Cthonia
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tattered pennant carried from the Legion's first home. Every model in the unit gains Cthonian Spirit.

wargear.name: Chieftain's war-horn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A long ivory horn that carries across a battlefield. Gives the model War-horn Call.

wargear.name: Spiked ram-plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hooked prow-blade for tearing through barricades and infantry. The vehicle gains Spiked Prow.

wargear.name: Death-oath sigil
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A rune sworn to avenge any brother who falls beside the bearer. Gives the model Oath of Vengeance.

wargear.name: Claim-spike standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A barbed pole driven into captured ground. Every model in the unit gains Planted Standard.

rites.name: The Mournival's Word
rites.flavor: Four captains speak, and the Legion moves as one voice.
benefits: Chieftain, Praetorian Command and Centurion Command Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every Command and High Command model gains +1 Willpower and Voice of the Mournival: friendly units within 12" of it pass Morale and Pinning checks automatically.
limitations: At least two High Command units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Mournival's Word: +1 WP, Voice of the Mournival.

require.note: The Mournival needs at least two High Command units.

rites.name: The Spear of Cthonia
rites.flavor: Where the Warmaster walks, the Justaerin walk one pace ahead.
benefits: Justaerin Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots.
Justaerin gain Deep Strike and Spear Point: on the turn they arrive by Deep Strike they may Charge with no penalty and add +1 to their Hit Tests in that Combat.
limitations: Horus Lupercal, Horus Ascended or Ezekyle Abaddon must lead the army, and at least one Justaerin Squad is required.
Every Justaerin Squad must start the battle in Reserve.
No Fast Attack or Recon units, and nothing with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: The Spear of Cthonia: Deep Strike, Spear Point.

require.note: Horus or Abaddon must lead the Spear.
Bring at least one Justaerin Squad.

rites.name: Reaver Doctrine
rites.flavor: Strike the vox-tower, kill the legate, be gone before the sirens finish.
benefits: Reaver Attack and Reaver Aggressor Squads may fill Troops slots.
Reaver squads gain Outflank and Reaver Raid: on the turn they arrive from Reserves they add +2 to their Charge roll.
limitations: Every Reaver squad must start the battle in Reserve, and at least one is required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

require.note: Bring at least one Reaver squad.

rites.name: The Warmaster's Favour
rites.flavor: Every recruit in the Legion believes his name was spoken at Horus's elbow.
benefits: Inductii Squads gain Sworn to Horus: they pass Morale and Pinning checks automatically while Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended is on the table.
limitations: Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended must lead, and at least two Inductii Squads are required.
No more than three High Command units, and no Malefic units.

modifiers.text: The Warmaster's Favour: Sworn to Horus.

limit.note: No more than three High Command units.

rules.name: Voice of the Mournival
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Mournival's Word). A model with this rule steadies the Legion around it. While a friendly Sons of Horus unit is within 12" of a model with this rule, it adds +1 to its Leadership and Cool for Morale and Pinning checks.

rules.name: Spear Point
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Spear of Cthonia). A unit with this rule that arrives by Deep Strike may declare a Charge on the turn it arrives without the usual penalty, and adds +1 to its Hit Tests in the Combat that follows.

rules.name: Reaver Raid
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Reaver Doctrine). A unit with this rule that arrives from Reserves may add +2 to the distance rolled for a Charge on the turn it arrives.

rules.name: Sworn to Horus
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Warmaster's Favour). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Leadership and Cool for Morale and Pinning checks for as long as Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended is on the battlefield.

rules.name: Victor's Laurel
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit led by a model with this rule adds 1 to its Charge rolls.

rules.name: Cthonian Spirit
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule treats any Charge roll of less than 5 as a 5.

rules.name: War-horn Call
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of its Movement phase, the unit of a model with this rule may ignore the Pinned or Suppressed Status.

rules.name: Spiked Prow
rules.text: Legacy house rule. When a vehicle with this rule moves through an enemy unit, increase the number of Hits it inflicts by 1.

rules.name: Oath of Vengeance
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A model with this rule gains +1 Attack in any Combat in which a friendly model of its unit was removed earlier in the turn.

rules.name: Planted Standard
rules.text: Legacy house rule. When the unit of a model with this rule is counted for Controlling an Objective, it counts as having two additional models.

armyRules.name: Lupercal's Vanguard
armyRules.condition: from the third battle turn, until the unit has fought in a Combat
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Sixteenth strike first and strike hard. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Charge rolls on the turn it arrives from Reserves and on the first battle turn. A host that stalls loses its nerve: from the third battle turn, until it has fought in a Combat, it suffers -1 Cool.

armyRules.name: Mournival Pride
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Proud captains who fight under the Warmaster's eye add 1 to their Focus Rolls in Challenges. They may never decline a Challenge, and if one is slain, every friendly Sons of Horus unit within 12" must make a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Status.

armyRules.name: Hubris of the Sixteenth
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion has never lost a war and acts like it. A unit with this rule ignores the Pinned Status, but suffers -1 Intelligence for being sure of itself.
